answers.reason: The president leads the university and chairs its central bodies, of which the senate is the primary one deciding overall strategy and structure.
Budget allocation is the primary domain of the chancellor, and every member only takes part in one place where their specific matters are decided.
The president only participates in their designated central body and does not sit in committees dealing with other delimited questions like appointments.
The faculty council is chaired by the dean and handles faculty-level affairs, where higher central officers do not sit.
The study commission deals with teaching and degree programmes at the faculty level, which falls outside the president's single designated body.
Examination matters are strictly separated from university leadership, and higher office holders do not sit in bodies for other kinds of questions.
This round awards internal faculty grants, and the president does not participate in faculty-level or non-central bodies.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specific teaching task outside the president's single area of participation.
Choosing laboratory equipment is a delimited operational matter in which the president has no participation rights.
Planning the orientation week for new students is outside the central leadership body to which the president is restricted.
